# Condition

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Condition`](gmeow-Condition.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Condition>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)

A describable circumstance — the trigger of a conditional norm, the activation context of a persona, the antecedent of a causal link. The canonical form is PROSE ([`gmeow:conditionText`](../properties/gmeow-conditionText.md), mandatory by SHACL); machine formalizations attach via [`gmeow:formalizedAs`](../properties/gmeow-formalizedAs.md), and each formalization is a claim of equivalence to the prose, challengeable through the statement layer. Whether the condition held at some moment is a [`gmeow:ConditionEvaluation`](gmeow-ConditionEvaluation.md) — a vantage-indexed [`Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md) — never a graph entailment. The ontology stores conditions; it never executes them ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Condition`](gmeow-Condition.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
